mission_1.welcome: Namaste! Welcome to Agra, home of the magnificent Taj Mahal!
facts: Did you know? The Taj Mahal changes color depending on the time of day!
The Taj Mahal is made of white marble and took over 20 years to build.

monument.title: The Taj Mahal
monument.description: One of the Seven Wonders of the World, built on the banks of the Yamuna River. Known worldwide for its beautiful white marble dome and gardens.

mission_2.welcome: Har Har Gange! We have arrived at ancient Varanasi on the banks of the holy River Ganga!
facts: Varanasi is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world!
Thousands of earthen lamps are floated on the Ganga river during Dev Deepawali.

monument.title: Ganga Ghats of Varanasi
monument.description: Historic riverfront steps along the sacred River Ganga, famous for evening Ganga Aarti ceremonies and rich cultural heritage.

mission_3.welcome: Swagatham! Welcome to Kerala — God's Own Country, land of coconuts and spices!
facts: Kerala grows over 70% of India's spices, including black pepper known as 'Black Gold'!
Kathakali dancers wear colorful face paint and elaborate costumes to tell ancient stories.

monument.title: Kerala Backwaters & Spice Hills
monument.description: A serene network of interconnected canals, rivers, and lakes surrounded by lush palm groves and aromatic spice plantations.
